BIO.short_bio: Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience specializing in Laravel, React, TypeScript, and enterprise ERP & workflow automation.
BIO.long_bio: I'm Md. Al Amin, a Software Engineer with 4+ years of professional experience developing and maintaining web-based and enterprise applications. I specialize in PHP, Laravel, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue.js, and MySQL — architecting solutions for ERP, procurement (P2P), accounting, HRM, biometric attendance integrations, and business workflow automation.
BIO.description:
👋 Hi, I'm Md. Al Amin, a passionate Software Engineer specializing in Laravel & React, dedicated to building seamless and user-friendly enterprise web applications.

💻 Back-end Expertise: Specializing in PHP, Laravel, and Python to develop robust and scalable applications.

⚛️ Front-end Skills: Proficient in React.js, Vue.js, Inertia.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, and JavaScript.

🚀 Modern Tools: Experienced with Vite, Docker, Postman, Composer, and Git.

🗃️ Database Management: Skilled in MySQL, database design, and query optimization.

⚡ Workflow Automation & Integration: Enterprise ERP, procurement (P2P), attendance biometric middleware, and REST APIs.
BIO.career_summary:
🎓 I graduated with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Engineering from Daffodil Institute of IT in 2022 (CGPA: 3.18). Since then, I have worked across multiple roles, currently as a Software Engineer at Ambala IT, where I specialize in back-end and front-end development using PHP, Laravel, React, TypeScript, and MySQL.

💼 Previously, I worked as a Full-Stack Web Developer at Nano Information Technology (Nanosoft) and as a Support Engineer at One Sky Communications Limited, gaining extensive experience in web development and technical infrastructure. 🌱
